title: cli: os test --url with a trailing slash sends //api/v1/... and fails every HTTP scenario 404

立卡门类别: ① 产品缺陷 — 具名落点 (`HttpTestAdapter`, packages/core/src/qa/http-adapter.ts) + 复现
reach: 公开入口实测一次错误结果 — `os test --url http://localhost:PORT/` fails every HTTP scenario 404 where the same URL without the slash passes (three runs at 7fa9873f)
业务理由: a developer or CI job that points `os test` at a deployment URL copied with its trailing slash sees every scenario fail 404 and no hint why, which reads as a broken app. Not doing it: false-red QA suites and time lost hunting a non-bug.
动手的读者: the domain:devx seat (CLI `os test` and the QA adapter); triage first touch confirms the lane, then os-dev.
查重: `"os test" url slash` → 22 hits, 0 open; `http-adapter` → 813 hits, 2 open (#27285, #26472 — unrelated: plugin hot attach, OAuth issuer). No duplicate.

QA-source: #28942 · cli.qa-suite-execution · observed beside the clauses

**What happens.** `os test --url http://host:port/` (with a trailing slash) sends every request to `//api/v1/...`, which the server answers 404, so every HTTP scenario fails. Only `wait` steps pass. `api_call` failures do not name the URL they addressed, so the cause is invisible.

**Mechanism.** `HttpTestAdapter` (`packages/core/src/qa/http-adapter.ts`: `rawApiCall`, `collectionUrl`, the discovery probe) concatenates `${this.baseUrl}${endpoint}` without normalising a trailing `/`.

**Reproduction** (stock showcase boot on PORT at 7fa9873f; reproduced three times):
1. From `examples/app-showcase`: `os test --url http://localhost:PORT/ --token ADMIN_TOKEN`.
   - Expected: the same as without the slash, `SUCCESS: All 2 scenarios passed.`
   - Actual: both scenarios ❌ `HTTP Error 404: {"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}`, `FAILED: 2 scenarios failed. 0 passed.`, exit 1.
2. An 8-step sweep suite against the same URL: 7 ❌, only `wait` passes. Record actions name the cause (`record actions addressed http://localhost:PORT//api/v1/data … GET http://localhost:PORT//api/v1/discovery answered 404`); `api_call` gives no hint.
3. Control: `--url http://localhost:PORT` → all pass.

**Fix direction:** strip trailing slashes from `--url` in `Test.run` or the adapter constructor, and have an `api_call` 404 name the URL it addressed, as the record actions already do.

Full evidence: QA run record #28942.
